entity.name: Uzer Kayat
entity.description: I am an independent developer from India and the creator and solo maintainer of AI Productivity Flow. I started building the project to solve a problem I personally had with consuming long text and information, and it has grown into an open-source desktop AI system for Windows and macOS combining voice dictation, audio summaries, and visual explainer videos. I have built the project independently from scratch as a free, open-source application.

projects.name: AI Productivity Flow
projects.description:
AI Productivity Flow is a free and open-source desktop AI system for Windows and macOS designed to let users transform information without leaving the application they are already working in. It combines three system-wide workflows: Video Flow for turning text, articles, documents, and code into narrated visual explanations, Audio Flow for reading or summarising selected text, and Voice Flow for speech-to-text dictation and text injection.

The application is designed around user control and local-first operation. It supports local speech recognition, offline summarisation, and local text-to-speech, while optional cloud AI features use a Bring-Your-Own-Key model rather than a developer-controlled AI service.

plans.name: Productivity Flow — 3-Month Open-Source Development Grant
plans.description: Seeking INR 60,000 for 3 months of focused open-source development of Productivity Flow. Month 1: release hardening, security, Windows testing, installer validation, docs, and critical fixes. Month 2: improve Video, Audio, and Voice Flow using early user feedback and fix compatibility/reliability issues. Month 3: expand testing, stabilize the release, improve contributor docs, and publish a public progress update.
